# Standard Support

> A convention for how AI agents ask for support (draft 0.5). Three things an agent can do: ask for help
> (answered from the product's documentation), send feedback (one-way), and open a ticket with the product's team,
> through two small MCP tools (support reads, support_send sends) or the same HTTP endpoints, with a watch URL per
> ticket so a later session can pick up the reply. A design to copy,
> not a protocol to conform to. Made by DocSpring.

- [The whole site as Markdown](https://standardsupport.dev/index.md): the example, why, the spec, questions and adopters
- [The spec](https://standardsupport.dev/spec.md): every tool, field, status and rule, with its reason
- [The agent skill](https://github.com/DocSpring/standardsupport/tree/main/skills/standard-support): builds it into an existing MCP server
- [The reference server](https://github.com/DocSpring/standardsupport/tree/main/examples/reference-server): a small working example in TypeScript
